atomic_facts.fact: A black tray containing dark liquid sits in the center of the frame.
A dirty white block rests in the bottom-left corner.
Thick dark cables hang above the tray.

spatial: The black tray is in the center, positioned below the hanging cables. The white block is to the left of the tray. The reddish-brown surface is to the right of the tray.
